## Problem Statement
What friction or limitation are you trying to solve when working with programmatic AWS credentials without web console or CLI access?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how the feature or new AWS service module (e.g., CloudWatch Logs, Secrets Manager, SQS, DynamoDB) should work from a visual desktop UX perspective.

## Required IAM Permissions (Optional)
If this involves AWS APIs, list the primary IAM actions involved (for example `logs:FilterLogEvents` or `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue`) so friendly `AccessDenied` messages can be included.

## Additional Context
Add any wireframes, workflows, or examples here.
